title: Clear stale packet data in a reused HLS buffer
expected_output_summary: A hardened version of inputs/packet_kernel.cpp implementing void process_packet(const unsigned char in_buf[32], int length, unsigned char out_buf[32]) such that every invocation fully populates all 32 bytes of out_buf using only that call's own in_buf and length, with no dependence on any prior call's state. For each index i in [0,32): out_buf[i] must equal ((in_buf[i] ^ 0xA5) + i) & 0xFF when i < length, and must equal 0x00 when i >= length. Must compile cleanly with g++ using fixed 32-iteration loops, no dynamic allocation, and no recursion.
interface: void process_packet(const unsigned char in_buf[32], int length, unsigned char out_buf[32]);
